artifactLayout: Reproducible audit archive: 1200/packages, 1200/state, 1200/evidence, fresh, extra, trusted-pipeline, scripts and verification reports; all actual outputs captured base64. Archive hash and downloads in final parent response.

40806213.reason: Updates the maximum only inside the loop over later frequency groups. For n=1 the largest frequency group (5 in 0012) has no later group, so prints 4 rather than 5.

40813870.reason: Initializes each type with one participant then increments once per requested participant, causing an off-by-one allocation. For n=m=100 and one type on 0007, prints 0 instead of 1.

40815402.reason: Candidate days use range(1,m), excluding the maximum feasible m. For n=m=1 with food type 100 on 0005 prints 0 instead of 1.

40834472.reason: Searches food labels only over range(m), not the valid type domain 1..100. On 0004 all nine packages have label 42 and n=3, so ignores them and prints 0 instead of 3. The recorded test terminates normally; REs on other tests are not counted as proof.

40835937.reason: The one-group branch always prints 1, ignoring participant demand. For n=100,m=1,type=1 on 0002 prints 1 instead of impossible 0. The recorded test terminates normally; REs on other tests are not counted as proof.
